name: hp-database-search
description: HP Database Search System with user authentication

scripts.setup-db: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const { exec } = require('child_process'); exec(`psql ${process.env.DATABASE_URL} -f database.sql`, (error, stdout, stderr) => { if (error) { console.error(' Error setting up database:', error.message); return; } console.log(' Database setup completed successfully'); })"
scripts.deploy: npm install && npm run generate-sql && npm run setup-db && npm start

author: HP Database Team
